title: Paperless-ngx
autoHint: Choose an existing Paperless tag. Bauplan checks up to 25 existing and new matches per server-side pass every 5 minutes. Only local documents are created, not offers or expenses. Paperless is unchanged.
autoConsent: Share local copies of all documents with this tag with all approved Bauplan members.
urlHint: Base URL of your Paperless instance, without /api. The server URL must be reachable from Bauplan. The browser URL is used only for links.
instanceWarning: Changing the instance disconnects personal accounts. Existing document links are retained.
tokenHint: Create a token in your Paperless profile. It is encrypted on the Bauplan server and never shared with other members. Upload permission is required for archiving.
sharing: Search results are private to your connection. Importing a document shares its local copy with all approved Bauplan project members.
exportHint: Selected files are sent using your personal Paperless account. Local files are retained. Each Bauplan document has one shared Paperless link.
disabled: An administrator must enable and configure Paperless first.
notConnected: Connect your own Paperless account in Settings to search, transfer or check documents.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect your personal Paperless account? Active transfers may require reconnection. Local documents and links remain.
imported: Document imported. Review the suggested fields before saving.
alreadyImported: This document or a byte-identical file already exists in Bauplan. No duplicate was created.
errors.tag_removed: The document no longer has the selected import tag.
presenceHint: Filters show known links, not a live inventory. Unlinked files may already exist in Paperless. Access errors do not prove deletion.
selectionLimit: Select at most 50 documents per transfer.
dateHint: Use the date printed on the document, not its upload, due or payment date.
submitted: Transfer status updated. Check each document; only a confirmed link means archiving is complete.
skipped: {{count}} already linked or unresolved documents were skipped.
verified: Status check completed. See the result on each document.
inaccessible: Not accessible to your account; link retained
reconcileHint: Paperless may already contain the file. Find and link the existing document before considering another upload. A matching filename alone is not proof of matching content.
abandonConfirm: Stop tracking this transfer? Paperless may still process or retain a copy. This does not cancel remote processing. Another transfer could create a duplicate.
reanalyzeConfirm: Run local analysis? Unsaved field edits in this dialog will be replaced.
suggestions: Suggestions from Paperless. Check all fields before applying.
noSuggestions: No usable Paperless text was available. Enter fields manually or run local analysis.
errors.not_connected: Connect your personal Paperless account first.
errors.encryption_key: The administrator must configure PAPERLESS_SETTINGS_KEY as a 64-character hexadecimal secret on the server.
errors.unauthorized: Paperless rejected your token. Reconnect your personal account.
errors.forbidden: Your Paperless account does not have permission for this action.
errors.not_found: The Paperless resource is missing or not accessible to your account.
errors.timeout: Paperless did not respond in time.
errors.rate_limited: Paperless is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
errors.response_too_large: The Paperless response or file exceeds the allowed size.
errors.unsupported_type: This file format is not supported for transfer.
errors.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, query or fragment.
errors.active_transfer: This document has an active or unresolved transfer. Resolve it before changing or deleting the file.
errors.already_linked: This document is already linked to Paperless.
errors.submission_unknown: The transfer outcome is unknown. Reconcile it before uploading again.
errors.credentials_invalid: Your encrypted token cannot be read. Reconnect your personal account.
errors.invalid_endpoint: The requested Paperless endpoint is not allowed.
errors.remote_error: Paperless rejected the request. Check the service and try again.
errors.incompatible_api: This Paperless API response is not supported.
errors.unsafe_pagination: Paperless returned an unsafe pagination address. No credentials were forwarded.
errors.metadata_limit: The Paperless metadata list exceeds the supported limit.
errors.file_missing: The original file is empty, missing or unavailable.
errors.file_size: The file is empty or exceeds the upload limit.
errors.unresolved_task: The processing result does not identify a usable document. Resolve the transfer manually.
errors.document_missing: The local document is missing. Offline uploads must finish synchronizing first.
errors.invalid_metadata: A selected tag, document type or correspondent is no longer available.
errors.job_missing: No transfer was found for this document.
errors.not_owner: Only the initiating account can resolve this transfer.
errors.job_changed: The transfer state changed. Refresh before trying again.
errors.confirmation_required: Confirm the duplicate risk before continuing.
errors.configuration_changed: The Paperless instance changed. Reconnect and resolve the previous transfer explicitly.
errors.remote_id_required: Select a Paperless document to link.
errors.content_mismatch: The Paperless original does not match the local file. No link was created.
errors.source_conflict: This Paperless document is already linked to a different Bauplan document.
errors.processing_timeout: Processing has not finished within the tracking period. Check the task or resolve it manually.
errors.processing_failed: Paperless could not process this document.
errors.duplicate: Paperless reports an existing copy. Find and link it; do not upload again blindly.
errors.internal_error: The transfer encountered an internal error. Its outcome must be checked.
errors.tracking_abandoned: Tracking was stopped. Paperless may still retain or process a copy.
errors.restored: This transfer came from a restored backup. Reconnect and reconcile it; no upload was replayed.
errors.disconnected: The initiating account disconnected Paperless. Reconnect to check or resolve the transfer.
errors.account_deleted: The initiating account was deleted. An administrator can abandon tracking; Paperless may retain a copy.
errors.extraction_failed: The file was imported, but field extraction failed. Enter fields manually or run local analysis.
errors.metadata_unavailable: The file was imported, but some Paperless metadata could not be loaded.
